title: The research campaign's calls keep Claude's thinking through the gateway, and team measurements are kept for the store
request: The owner: fix the agents the store never captured (workspace chat, team, campaign, twin's thinking), then run small capped live checks and show the data samples.
spec: Every campaign, campaign review and campaign live-eval request goes through the gateway, so Claude's API thinking summary (adaptive, display summarized) is kept with the exchange; the team measurement keeps its runs in a workspace folder the store collects; live checks prove each path with a real model.
plan: Find why each agent has no captured run or thinking
Route NOOA's typed requests through the gateway with one shared function
Keep the team measurement's projects, session log and ledger in a scripted workspace folder
Tests for the capture and the failure paths
Live checks with caps: workspace chat, campaign, team, twin

decisions.decision: Send the campaign's requests through the gateway instead of asking NOOA's litellm client for thinking
decisions.why: NOOA calls litellm's Responses API and always returns reasoning=None; the gateway already asks Claude for summarized thinking, keeps the whole exchange and holds the caps

decisions.decision: The typed answer is asked with the output model's JSON Schema in a system message and parsed by NOOA's own helpers
decisions.why: NOOA's PredictStrategy validates the parsed answer and retries a failed parse; no field asks for the model's reasons

decisions.decision: Usage is reported through a callback, before parsing, and later for a call the caller left
decisions.why: a thread cannot be cancelled: a paused or timed-out request still finishes and is paid, and a reply that does not parse is paid too

decisions.decision: The team measurement keeps the workspace's own gateway, not one opened on the kept folder
decisions.why: the monthly cap is counted from one usage log; a kept folder's would start empty and let a run spend past the cap; the store joins exchanges to runs by request id

decisions.decision: A Claude model name is passed only to an Anthropic tier; the record names the model that answered
decisions.why: the review found a GPT name credited for Claude's answers and a Claude name sent to a non-Anthropic tier

change: dclab_rnd.agentic.agents: gateway_call, as_response and through_gateway; AuditedClient.acall counts usage and the model that answered in the run ledger; ask credits the model that answered. dclab_rnd.agentic.guide_review and dclab_rnd.agentic.live_eval: their clients use through_gateway, no OpenAI key required, the model that answered recorded. dclab_rnd.agent_eval.team: measure(advisor, keep) keeps projects, session log and ledger in a scripted workspace folder (campaign_capture.recorded); main keeps by default under the live tests folder.

findings.defect: The research campaign kept no exchange and no thinking
findings.scenario: Campaign calls on two days were counted in the usage log and none was kept as an exchange
findings.cause: AuditedClient called NOOA's own litellm client; the gateway only checked the caps and counted the cost
findings.fix: every campaign request goes through the gateway (through_gateway)

findings.defect: The store had no team run at all
findings.scenario: Every team measurement built its projects in a temporary folder, so its run events were written nowhere the store reads
findings.cause: agent_eval.team created a ProjectStore in tempfile.mkdtemp and installed no session log
findings.fix: measure(advisor, keep) keeps the projects, the session log and the ledger in a scripted workspace folder

findings.defect: The campaign review and live eval credited a GPT model for Claude's answers
findings.scenario: With the Anthropic provider on, the review file said provider OpenAI Responses API and model gpt while the gateway's Claude answered
findings.cause: the records kept the model name asked for
findings.fix: the clients keep answered_by from the gateway; the payload, the status and the checks use it

findings.defect: The review and live eval refused to start without an OpenAI key
findings.scenario: On a machine with only the Anthropic key both stopped before any request
findings.cause: an OPENAI_API_KEY check left from the litellm path
findings.fix: the check asks whether the gateway serves the purpose
findings.test: none: both commands are run by hand

findings.defect: A paused or timed-out request was paid but missing from the run's usage
findings.scenario: Pause during a campaign call: the thread keeps running and the gateway charges it, but the run never counts it
findings.cause: asyncio.to_thread cannot be cancelled and its result was dropped
findings.fix: the call is shielded and a done callback reports its usage as abandoned

findings.defect: A reply that did not parse was missing from the run's usage
findings.scenario: Claude's answer does not fit the schema: the gateway charged it, the run's usage skipped it
findings.cause: the reply was parsed before its usage was reported
findings.fix: usage is reported first, then the reply is parsed

findings.defect: A Claude model name could be sent to a tier that is not Anthropic
findings.scenario: The standard tier is Anthropic but the strong tier points to a local server: the campaign's Claude name goes there and every call fails
findings.cause: the override checked the name only
findings.fix: the override is passed only when the purpose's tier is Anthropic

findings.defect: The live campaign check could not reach the gateway
findings.scenario: The live campaign failed on its first request in the agent environment
findings.cause: the agent environment has no Anthropic SDK, so the gateway serves nothing there; the old path used litellm
findings.fix: open: the SDK must be installed in the agent environment and added to its lock file, with the owner's agreement

findings.defect: A Claude routing label was trained with Home's thinking, not the labeller's
findings.scenario: A silver label from the routing labeller, where Home's intent reader gave the same answer first: the chat export took Home's thinking as the label's reason
findings.cause: chat_row took the first model reading with the same answer and a thinking summary
findings.fix: chat_row prefers the reading of the label's giver (label_by), then any reading with the same answer

findings.defect: The coverage said no kept exchange held the twin's thinking
findings.scenario: A live twin run kept every reply's thinking in its lane's transcripts/thinking.jsonl; the store files it as other, and the coverage read thinking from model_exchanges only
findings.cause: the twin lane's own client writes its thinking transcript instead of the gateway's exchange
findings.fix: the coverage counts the twin's thinking transcripts as kept replies with their thinking

findings.defect: The agent environment's model requests failed before reaching Claude
findings.scenario: The live campaign's first request raised ModuleNotFoundError in the agent environment
findings.cause: the gateway's pause check imported storage.db, which needs sqlalchemy, even with no database configured; the session log did the same
findings.fix: both read the database setting through storage.url and import the database module only when one is configured

findings.defect: A typed campaign answer came back empty
findings.scenario: The live campaign's experiment step used all of its 6,000 + 8,000 tokens thinking at high effort and returned no answer
findings.cause: the limit was NOOA's 6,000 tokens, sized for a call without thinking
findings.fix: campaign requests stream with a 16,000-token answer limit (plus the thinking headroom)

findings.defect: Exam exchanges were counted as lost thinking
findings.scenario: Since 28 October, 1,020 shape-only exchanges said the model thought and kept no text; every one belonged to a sealed exam run, shape only by rule
findings.cause: the gateway wrote one vague reason for three cases, so the coverage could not tell an exam from a loss
findings.fix: sealed_run marks the process; the kept exchange names the exam and the coverage no longer counts it as lost

measurements.name: team measurement live, kept
measurements.gate: three team runs recorded in the kept workspace with the roles' thinking summaries
measurements.result: three team runs completed and recorded; every role but the reporter kept its thinking summary; EUR 0.22; the gate's churn acceptance check failed as in the run before
limits: the team gate itself failed on one acceptance check that predates this change

measurements.name: workspace chat live
measurements.gate: one answered question with its run recorded and its thinking kept
measurements.result: answered, run recorded, three of five exchanges with the thinking summary kept redacted (the purpose sees table results); EUR 0.02

measurements.name: campaign live
measurements.gate: one campaign request through the gateway keeps its thinking summary
measurements.result: after the SDK, the pause import and the streaming limit: the run completed, five requests, all five with Claude's thinking summary kept; EUR 0.42

measurements.name: twin live
measurements.gate: a completed twin run whose Claude replies keep their thinking summary
measurements.result: both lanes completed; 25 of 32 Claude replies kept their thinking in the lane's transcript; EUR 1.16

outcome: The campaign, its review and its live eval now ask for and keep Claude's thinking through the gateway, with the cost and the model that answered recorded; team measurements are kept where the store collects them. Workspace chat and team are proven live; the campaign waits for the SDK in the agent environment.
lessons: A framework that keeps its own HTTP client loses the exchange even when the cost is counted
A measurement run in a temporary folder leaves nothing to train on
Moving a call into a thread changes what cancel means: count what is paid even when the caller is gone
risks: A request left by a pause still runs to its end in its thread
The campaign's typed answers now depend on JSON in the reply instead of the Responses API's structured output
